acceptanceCriteria: docs/DOGFOOD.md pre-change step names path impact on the intended files (or states when range impact applies), consistent with the daily-change-evidence-workflow spec.
The retained prechange-impact artifact name and meaning stay unchanged or the spec is updated in the same change.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the first complete Beamfall daily-path run (Beamfall scratch clone, change LCRES-15, BASE 0d7796be23efe4e2579408a5516b8aeff1a23008, bind 86fde0eb21d2e0fc41bfc06a4c06c9c3aef63e59; evidence retained in the session scratchpad beamfall-evidence/). Before any edit, range impact reports state OUT_OF_SCOPE with changedPathCount 0, so the documented pre-change consequence step produces nothing. Path impact on the intended files (`corvint impact <paths> --limit 10`) was the useful pre-change consequence evidence.
title: DOGFOOD: the pre-change `corvint impact --base $BASE` step is empty by construction before any edit
